keep.text: An item is reduced once it is within 24 hours of its use-by.

readme_rule.why: follows the out-of-date README: reduced within 24 hours of the use-by, to half price, from £1

quarter_off.why: guesses a round quarter off instead of the chat's 21%

over_469.why: off by one: an item at exactly £4.69 gets no sticker, where only items under £4.69 don't

readme_24_hours.why: follows the chat on the price rules but keeps the README's 24 hours, which the chat made 48
